summary: Graffiticode charting dialect — compiles to Apache ECharts (bar / line / pie + donut + nightingale-rose / scatter), single-series or composed via the `chart` wrapper.
in_scope: Bar, line, pie, and scatter chart series (pie includes donut via inner-radius and nightingale rose via rose-type; scatter plots XY points, optionally overlaid with a line such as a best-fit trend)
Multi-series compositions and dual y-axis layouts via the `chart` wrapper
Theming (dark / light), named ECharts color palettes, Tailwind v3 color tokens resolved to hex at compile time
Plotting data given inline in the request
out_of_scope: Relational / network charts (graph, sankey, tree, treemap, sunburst)
Radar, gauge, heatmap, boxplot, candlestick, funnel — out of scope for v1, slot in later
Interactive editing, formulas, or per-cell scoring (use L0166 for spreadsheets)
Fetching or transforming external data — L0173 plots only values supplied inline with the request
